name: whatsapp-assistant
description: Local WhatsApp MCP tools for Codex and Claude on macOS: scoped text reads, separately confirmed replies and constrained scheduled sends.

interface.shortDescription: WhatsApp MCP for Codex and Claude on macOS.
interface.longDescription: Find and summarize selected existing WhatsApp text chats through a local OpenWA/Chrome daemon. Interactive replies require separate confirmation; scheduled sends require a secret, narrowly scoped prior authorization. Tool results enter your chosen AI client's context and may reach its provider. Community source candidate, not an official integration.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent messages in the selected chat.
Draft a reply and wait for my confirmation.
